Translator's note: In an editorial comment on the
above letter the "Novosti Dnia" of 1-11-39 writes that,
although there is much to say against the attitude of its
writer, it is perfectly true that many housewives refuse to
reveal details of their meagre households. If the S.M.C.
investigations were aimed at an improvement of the existing
conditions, personal pride might give way to considerations
of public character and the S.M.C. might obtain the information
desired. The existing situation - for instance, exhorbitant
prices of products of first necessity and high rentals - can
and should be improved by adopting certain administrative
measures. While one is aware of the sanctity of private
ownership in Shanghai, one also knows that at times of emergency
the right of private ownership is liable to certain limitations,
and is not Shanghai passing through a period of emergency at
present? Can really nothing be done in this direction except
collecting of information? If the adoption of administrative
measures is impracticable for some reasons, stores could be
established by the Municipality from which various products
of first necessity could be distributed at normal prices.
In such circumstances one should act and not only
collect information.

....................
D.S.I.

with the publication earlier this

a report containing disrespectful re-
ferences to the Manchurian ruling
family and accusing Japan of
"ambitious designs in the north."

Russian Daily News.

Shanghai Manchukuo Commercial Deputy.

Dated 16th May, 1939.

Complaint against "Russian Daily News".

Inasmuch as the Council has the responsibility of censoring
the Press, I much regret to note that on Page 1 of the Russian
daily of 1st May published by the Publishing House at No.620
Avenue Foch, International Settlement, there is a groundless report
couched in terms of disrespect to the Imperial House of the Manchu
Empire and also a statement that Japan, an ally of Manchukuo, seems
to harbour territorial ambitions against the said Empire.

This false report, which constitutes less-majesty, was fabricat-
ed with the object of damaging the friendly relations, and creating
ill-feelings between Japan and Manchukuo. Those who are informed on
the actual conditions in Manchukuo, cannot fail to see the falsity
of the report.

The Manchu Empire and her ally Japan are working on a basis
of close relationship to build up a new order in East Asia, and
to achieve a historic feat of supreme importance. We firmly believe
that Manchukuo is the foundation on which East Asia is to be re-
constructed.

In the meantime, the fruitless war of resistance continues,
and China is being ruined. The mistakes made by the Chungking
Government in directing the moral life of the Chinese nation, are
not known to the people, who have been thrown into a state of
excitement. The Chinese public must be clearly informed of the
actual conditions in Manchukuo so that they may realize the
significance of a new order in East Asia, and the three countries,
Japan, Manchukuo and China, may enjoy real happiness. We, being
of the same race, should make known to the Chinese people the
experience we have gone through so that the Chinese people may
correct their own views as soon as possible. It is my principal
duty to bring about genuine friendship between the nationals of the
three countries, Japan, Manchukuo and China.

Considering my mission I cannot remain inactive in the face

译自上海满洲国商务副代表致主席的信函。

日期：1939年5月16日。

控告《俄罗斯日报》。

鉴于工部局董事会负有审查新闻界的责任，我很遗憾地注意到，5月1日出版的俄文日报第一页（由国际租界霞飞路620号出版社出版）上，有一篇毫无根据的报道，措辞对满洲帝国皇室不敬，并且还声称日本作为满洲国的盟友，似乎对该帝国怀有领土野心。

这篇构成大不敬罪的虚假报道，其捏造目的在于损害友好关系，并在日本与满洲国之间制造恶感。任何了解满洲国实际情况的人，都不难看出该报道的虚假性。

满洲帝国及其盟友日本正基于密切关系，致力于建立东亚新秩序，并完成一项具有至高重要性的历史壮举。我们坚信，满洲国是重建东亚的基础。

与此同时，无效的抵抗战争仍在继续，中国正遭受破坏。重庆政府在指导中华民族精神生活方面所犯的错误，不为民众所知，民众被置于一种激动状态之中。必须向中国人民清楚地通报满洲国的实际情况，以便他们认识到东亚新秩序的意义，使日本、满洲国和中国三国人民享受真正的幸福。我们同宗同源，有责任向中国人民告知我们所经历的经验，以便中国人民尽快纠正自己的观点。促成日本、满洲国和中国三国国民之间的真正友谊是我的主要职责。

考虑到我的使命，面对

pages.en:
I
of the unfortunate incident which occurred recently in the area
under the Council's jurisdiction. There are numerous problems,
arising out of the present conditions of the Shanghai Settlement,
which must be solved once and for all. I cannot understand why up
to the time of the present case the Council has allowed full freedom
to the said newspaper which takes advantage of the special position
of the Settlement to indulge in anti-Manchukuo and anti-Japanese
propaganda, and why no steps have been taken to curb such activity.
Moreover, the journal in question has not only been consistently
hostile towards Japan and Manchukuo, but it is closely connected
with the Communist Party. It is the Council's serious responsibility
in exercising its function to maintain peace and good order in the
Settlement; not to deal properly with this highly harmful publica-
tion is to fail to act up to the responsibility.

    I now venture to request the Council to take adequate steps
to deal with this matter. At the same time I beg to present the
following three demands, and I hope also that the Council will
effectively guarantee that no similar incidents will recur in
future. The demands are:-

    1. That the said newspaper, "Russian Daily News", be
       ordered to suspend publication forthwith.

    2. That the paper be not allowed to resume publication
       under whatever new name.

    3. That the Editor-in-chief, S.I. Veis, of the said
       newspaper be severely punished.

    It is hoped that the above demands will be sincerely and effec-
tively complied with. Reply solicited.

                    (Signed and chopped)

                        Wong Ch'ing-tsang

            Commercial Deputy for Manchukuo in Shanghai.

关于近期在工部局管辖区域内发生的不幸事件。鉴于上海租界目前的状况，存在许多必须彻底解决的问题。我不理解为何直至本案发生之时，工部局仍允许该报享有完全的自由，利用租界的特殊地位肆意进行反“满洲国”及反日宣传，且未采取任何措施遏制此类活动。此外，该刊物不仅一贯对日本和“满洲国”持敌对态度，而且与共产党关系密切。维持租界内的和平与良好秩序是工部局行使职能时的严肃责任；若不妥善处置这份危害极大的出版物，即是未能履行其责任。

    兹冒昧请求工部局采取适当措施处理此事。同时，谨提出以下三项要求，并希望工部局能有效保证今后不再发生类似事件。要求如下：-

    1. 命令上述报纸《俄罗斯日报》（Russian Daily News）立即停刊。

    2. 不允许该报以任何新名称复刊。

    3. 严惩上述报纸的主编 S.I. Veis。

    恳请真诚且有效地满足上述要求。盼复。

                    （签名并盖章）

                        黄庆藏 (Wong Ch'ing-tsang)

            “满洲国”驻上海商务副代表。

Commissioner.

Sir,

The article complained of appeared in the "Novosti
Dnia" on May 1 and is abbreviated copy from the Evening
Post & Mercury of April 29. I take it that it is Chilikin
these people are after as there is much more room for
complaint in the Evening Post article.

On May 5 I warned Chilikin that he was not on such

was copy from another paper. He assured me that he had no
intention of causing trouble and would see to it that my
advice was followed.

I attach cuttings from the "Novosti Dnia" of May 1
and 5 and Evening Post of April 29, all bearing on this
complaint.

"Novosti Dnia", May 5, 1939. Published by the Russian
Publishing Co., 620 Avenue Foch. Editor - Mr.A.I.Veiss.

From the Editor of the "Novosti Dnia"

Yesterday the Japanese News Agency "Domei" sent out to
all newspapers bulletins containing an article from the
Japanese newspaper "Tairiku Shimpo", in which our journal
is accused with having insulted the Throne of Manchukuo
and with the intention of causing a breach of the peace
in the International Settlement. The article of the
"Tairiku Shimpo" as well as the comments of the "Domei"
News Agency are a tissue of lies and provocation from the
beginning to the end their sole aim being to discredit the
good name of our journal and to create an impression in the
official circles that the newspaper "Novosti Dnia" does not
conform with the regulations governing the maintenance of the
peace and order in Shanghai.
All this compels us, the newspaper "Novosti Dnia", to apply
to the Imperial Japanese Consular Court in order to defend
our good name and to accuse the "Domei" News Agency and the
newspaper "Tairiku Shimpo" with libel, defamation, prejudicing
public confidence and inciting one part of the population
against another.
Maitre Paul Premet is our legal advisor.

Certified true copy:
H. C. Sandley

《今日新闻》编辑声明

昨日，日本通讯社“同盟通信社”（Domei）向所有报社发送了包含日本报纸《大陆新报》（Tairiku Shimpo）一篇文章的简报，文中指责本刊侮辱“满洲国”皇统，并意图在国际租界内破坏和平。《大陆新报》的文章以及“同盟通信社”的评论从头到尾都是谎言和挑衅，其唯一目的旨在败坏本刊的良好声誉，并在官方圈子中造成一种印象，即《今日新闻》报社不符合维护上海和平与秩序的法规。

Paul Premet 律师是我们的法律顾问。

"Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" dated April 29, 1939.

THE SICK GIRL OF ASIA

Conquest March of Japan halted by Lack of Heir
No Son Born to Wife of Manchukuo Emperor
Pu Yi awaiting Throne of China.

Yueh Hua is beautiful fragile - consumptive. Yet this lovely Manchu lady, the epitome of helplessness, has balked the plans of the empire-building Japanese so effectively that until the agile brains of the "little brown men" can devise some new strategic move, their whole program of ruling China has been halted.

The story is a simple one, one of love. Yueh Hua is the wife Pu-Yi, "Son of Heaven". Pu-Yi loves his wife - and this baffles the Japanese.

Five years ago, on the bitterly cold plains of Manchuria, Mr. Henry Pu-Yi stepped from his three-ton armoured car to go through the 3000-year-old rites which assertedly made him "Kang Teh" Emperor of the new State of Manchukuo.

MANDATE FROM HEAVEN

"I have received a mandate from Heaven", he said, "to rule the Chinese peoples."

But no one took either the man or the announcement seriously; that is, no one except Mr. Henry Pu-Yi himself. In the calculating eyes of the Japanese he was not even an individual. To them he was merely a royal puppet, that would jump when they pulled the strings. Mr. Pu-Yi, in the eyes of the Japanese, was a very convenient person to establish as the most important figure in China on whom to hang their plans which called for swift conquest of the centuries-old country.

The Japanese looked for no trouble from their newly throned Emperor. They expected him to do exactly as they ordered. There seemed no reason for him to think otherwise. Pu-Yi was not an imposing figure five years ago. Impotent in appearance, he was shy in the presence of strangers, childish in his treatment of the world.
pages.zh:
1939年4月29日的《上海晚邮报与水星报》。

亚洲的病弱少女

日本的征服进军因缺乏继承人而停滞
“满洲国”皇帝之妻未生子
溥仪等待中国皇位。

岳华（Yueh Hua）美丽而脆弱——患有肺痨。然而，这位可爱的满族女士，无助的典型代表，却如此有效地挫败了致力于建立帝国的日本人的计划，以至于在这些“小个子棕色人种”敏捷的大脑想出新的战略举措之前，他们统治中国的整个计划都已停滞。

故事很简单，是一个关于爱情的故事。岳华是“天子”溥仪的妻子。溥仪爱他的妻子——这让日本人感到困惑。

五年前，在满洲严寒的平原上，亨利·溥仪先生走下他那辆三吨重的装甲车，去履行那项据称使他成为新国家“满洲国”“康德”皇帝的有着3000年历史的仪式。

天命

“我受命于天，”他说，“来统治中国人民。”

但没有人把这个人或这则公告当真；也就是说，除了亨利·溥仪先生本人之外，没人当真。在日本人精于算计的眼中，他甚至不算一个个个体。对他们来说，他只是一个皇家傀儡，他们会牵线让他跳动。在日本人眼中，溥仪是一个非常方便的人选，被树立为中国最重要的人物，以便将他们迅速征服这个古老国家的计划寄托在他身上。

日本人对他们新登基的皇帝不抱有任何麻烦的预期。他们期望他完全按照他们的命令行事。似乎没有理由让他产生其他想法。五年前的溥仪并非一个令人印象深刻的人物。外表看来无能，在陌生人面前害羞，对待世界的方式像个孩子。

pages.en:
- 2 -

WITHOUT WILL

To the Japanese he seemed without will, possessing limited intelligence. Machinery of all kinds fascinated this appointed ruler of the Chinese people. He liked to take things apart, anything from watches to motorcars, try to put them back together again. His greatest wish was to travel to America, visit an automobile plant. He often expressed a desire to work in one. He seemed a perfect puppet.

The Japanese wanted to make this pliable tool the Emperor of all China. He was the last of the Manchu dynasty to rule, having twice been on the Dragon Throne. Thousands of Chinese considered him the real ruler of China. They wanted him back. The Japanese expected to place him on the throne of China in the Forbidden City of Peking, after that city was captured. They knew that such an action would have a stabilizing effect throughout the whole of the country and its territories.

EMPEROR WORSHIP

There is little doubt that the Japanese were right in their calculations. For centuries the Chinese actually and literally worshipped their emperors. Pu-Yi was the "Son of Heaven", appointed to rule over them, and many Chinese have not been able to shake off this conviction in the quarter century since the Manchu throne was overthrown.

The Japanese were so confident of the success of their plans that they had caused the work of renovation to be started even before their armies marched into North China. Crumbling arches in the Forbidden City, and elsewhere in China were replaced. General reconstruction was inaugurated. A large part of China's ancient treasures in Japan and Manchuria were made ready for transfer to the city, in order that the capital might be complete.

WAITING FOR CALL

His Majesty waited in Hsinking, the capital of Manchukuo for the people of China proper to call for him. As his
pages.zh:
- 2 -

缺乏意志

在日本人看来，他似乎缺乏意志，智力有限。各种机械让这位被任命的中国人民统治者着迷。他喜欢把东西拆开，从手表到汽车任何东西都拆，再试着装回去。他最大的愿望是去美国，参观一家汽车工厂。他经常表示希望在其中工作。他看起来像个完美的傀儡。

日本人想让这个顺手的工具成为全中国的皇帝。他是统治过的满清王朝的最后一人，曾两次登上龙椅。成千上万的中国人认为他是中国的真正统治者。他们希望他回来。日本人预计在北京城被攻占后，将他扶上北京紫禁城的皇位。他们知道，这样的举动将在全国及其领土范围内产生稳定效应。

皇帝崇拜

毫无疑问，日本人的计算是正确的。几个世纪以来，中国人实际上并从字面上崇拜他们的皇帝。溥仪是“天子”，受命统治他们，许多中国人在满清皇位被推翻后的四分之一个世纪里，一直未能摆脱这种信念。

日本人对他们计划的成功如此自信，甚至在军队开进华北之前就开始了翻新工作。紫禁城内及中国其他地方的 crumbling arches（原文不清，意为破损的拱门/建筑）被替换。全面重建工作正式启动。存放在日本和满洲的中国大部分古代珍宝已准备好转运至该城市，以使首都完备。

等待召唤

陛下在“满洲国”首都新京等待中国本土人民的召唤。由于他在

pages.en:
- 3 -

in Manchukuo was only a temporary one, no provision was made
for a proper royal residence. He lived in the old residence
of the Salt Tax Collection Headquarters.

He is still waiting for the call, in the same old resi-
dence, for Japanese plans concerning him began to go slightly
haywire, and the first monkey wrench in the machinery came from
an unexpected source.

CAREFUL UPBRINGING

Henry Pu-Yi was very carefully brought up as becomes a
young emperor. He lived a studious, secluded life with his
retinue upon such funds as he could obtain from the Revolu-
tionary Government, and upon the proceeds from sales of some
of his Imperial possessions.

He was taught the little his guardians deemed necessary.
Eunuchs and retainers swindled him outrageously, charging him
fantastic prices for everything he obtained. A penny pencil
cost $10. Perhaps as much as $50 would be demanded for a
common writing pad. He had absolutely no sense of values, and
paid what was asked. He obeyed instructions implicitly.
Sometimes he was able to obtain lessons and advice over the
telephone from Dr. Hu Shih, China's present Ambassador to
Washington, but he seldom talked with anyone outside his small
circle.

FIRST HAIRCUT

When he was 17 years old he received both his first hair-
cut and his first wife. He got the haircut because he had been
demanding one for years, a note because "court officials"
assumed that it was unthinkable that he remain single. He
chose his wife from a group of photographs of young Manchu
ladies of station.

Tush Bai was young and beautiful. She was kind and the
lonely de-throned young Emperor fell in love with her. Three
years later, when his "court officials" urged him to take three
concubines, he finally consented to take one. She left him
charging "cruelty" because he would not live with her.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

“满洲国”的地位只是暂时的，因此并未安排合适的皇家住所。他住在盐务稽核总所（Salt Tax Collection Headquarters）的旧宅邸中。

他仍然在同一座旧宅邸中等待召唤，因为日本人对他的计划开始有点乱套，而给机器运转带来第一个意外阻碍的来源出乎意料。

精心教养

亨利·溥仪作为年轻皇帝，受到了非常精心的教养。他与侍从过着 studious（原文意为好学的/勤勉的），隐居的生活，依靠他从革命政府那里能获得的资金，以及出售部分皇室财产所得的收入生活。

监护人认为必要的少量知识被传授给他。太监和侍从肆无忌惮地欺骗他，对他获得的每样东西都索取天价。一支值一分钱的铅笔要价10美元。一个普通的写字板可能要价高达50美元。他完全没有价值观念，要多少就给多少。他盲目服从指令。有时他能通过电话从现任中国驻华盛顿大使胡适博士那里获得课程和建议，但他很少与小圈子以外的人交谈。

第一次理发

当他17岁时，他迎来了第一次理发和第一位妻子。他得到理发是因为多年来他一直要求理发，而娶妻则是因为“朝廷官员”认为他保持单身是不可想象的。他从一群有地位的年轻满族女士的照片中选择了他的妻子。

图什·白（Tush Bai，音译）年轻貌美。她心地善良，这位孤独的废黜年轻皇帝爱上了她。三年后，当他的“朝廷官员”敦促他纳三位妾室时，他最终同意纳一位。她离开了他，指控他“残忍”，因为他不愿与她同居。

pages.en:
- 4 -

NO CHILDREN

Yueh Hua traveled with him to Manchuria and eventually
became his Empress. Only one cloud marred their happiness; they
had no children. And it was whispered about that the delicate
health of the Empress was responsible. About this time the
Japanese army became anxious. It was vitally important that
the future Emperor of all China have descendants. He was asked
to take another wife. Surprisingly, he refused to consider it.
Here was a disturbing factor which had been overlooked.
Events were not moving according to schedule.

NO INITIATIVE

Now, the Japanese are not people of individual initiative.
They must have according to plans which have been carefully
arranged and studied beforehand. Any disturbance of their
schedule causes consternation. When the unexpected happens,
the Japanese halt everything, until a new plan can be devised
which will carry them around the difficulty. Needless to say,
inactivity at this time could prove to be disastrous. And there
the Japanese stood.

But no, perhaps the new Emperor was merely being coy or
cheeky. He couldn't be serious. A sick wife? No heirs?
Non-sense! They would find him a beautiful, healthy mate, one
who would change Pu-Yi's mind about staying married to Yueh Hua.
Word went out that another wife was wanted. Perfect girls by
the score answered the appeal.

TUBERCULOSIS

Kang Teh, the puppet, was adamant. He announced firmly
that he already had one wife, and that was all he wanted.
Beauties from all over the East gathered, hoping he intended to
establish a harem. He sent them away. The Japanese gave up,
for there seemed no way around this particular difficulty. But
they found it hard to believe that fragile little Yueh Hua, who
had finally contracted tuberculosis could have created so much
havoc with their plans.

Peking fell to the Japanese two years later, but the
pages.zh:
- 4 -

无子嗣

岳华（Yueh Hua，音译）随他前往满洲，并最终成为他的皇后。只有一片乌云遮蔽了他们的幸福；他们没有孩子。坊间窃窃私语，称这是由皇后虚弱的健康状况所致。大约在此时，日本军队变得焦虑起来。全中国未来的皇帝拥有子嗣至关重要。他被要求再娶一妻。令人惊讶的是，他拒绝考虑此事。这是一个此前被忽视的令人不安的因素。事态并未按计划发展。

缺乏主动性

如今，日本人并非具有个人主动性的民族。他们必须依照事先精心安排和研究过的计划行事。任何对其时间表的干扰都会引起惊愕。当意外发生时，日本人会停止一切行动，直到制定出能帮助他们绕过困难的新计划。毋庸赘言，此时的不活动可能被证明是灾难性的。而日本人就僵持在那里。

但是，不，也许新皇帝只是在故作矜持或厚颜无耻。他不可能是认真的。病弱的妻子？没有继承人？胡说！他们会为他找一位美丽、健康的配偶，一位能改变溥仪关于与岳华保持婚姻想法的人。消息传出，寻求另一位妻子。数十位完美女孩响应了这一呼吁。

肺结核

傀儡康德（Kang Teh）态度坚决。他坚定地宣布，他已经有一位妻子，这就是他所需要的一切。来自东方的美女们聚集在一起，希望他打算建立后宫。他将她们遣散。日本人放弃了，因为似乎没有办法绕过这一特定困难。但他们很难相信，最终患上肺结核的脆弱小女子岳华，竟会给他们的计划造成如此大的破坏。

两年后，北平沦陷于日军之手，但

pages.en:
- 5 -

Forbidden City remains empty. And there is no indication
that Kang Teh will be installed there in the near future.
Japan has established provisional governments in her captured
territories, which are prepared to call for the Emperor, as
quickly as they receive their orders to do so. But it is
doubtful if this "spontaneous" shout will ever be heard.
It is probably too late, for the Chinese have devised a new
game called "catch the traitor" - and at the rate empire-minded
officials are being assassinated, there would be very few left
to welcome Pu-Yi if he should come. - Anthony Billingham in the
"Sunday Mirror".

Certified true copy:
H. C. Laidlay
pages.zh:
- 5 -

紫禁城依然空荡。也没有迹象表明康德将在不久的将来被安置在那里。日本在其占领区建立了临时政府，这些政府已准备好在接到命令后立即呼吁皇帝即位。但这种“自发”的呼声是否真能被听到，值得怀疑。可能为时已晚，因为中国人设计了一种名为“捉汉奸”的新游戏——按照那些怀有帝国野心的官员被暗杀的速度，如果溥仪前来，将几乎没有剩下的人来欢迎他。——安东尼·比林厄姆（Anthony Billingham）载于《星期日镜报》（"Sunday Mirror"）。

经核证无误副本：
H. C. Laidlay

Commissioner.

Sir,

The article complained of appeared in the
"Novosti Dnia" on May 1 and is abbreviated copy
from the Evening Post & Mercury of April 29.
I take it that it is Chilikin these people are
after as there is much more room for complaint
in the Evening Post article.

On May 5 I warned Chilikin that he was
not on such firm ground as the Evening Post and
for this reason alone it would be very much in
his own interests were he to cease publication of
news matter of this kind even although it was copy
from another paper. He assured me that he had
no intention of causing trouble and would see to
it that my advice was followed.

I attach cuttings from the "Novosti Dnia"
of May 1 and 5 and Evening Post of April 29, all
bearing on this complaint.

Sec SMC

阁下，

被投诉的文章刊登于5月1日的《Novosti Dnia》（今日新闻），系摘录自4月29日的《Evening Post & Mercury》（晚邮报与水星报）。我认为这些人针对的是奇利金（Chilikin，音译），因为《晚邮报》的文章中有更多可投诉之处。

5月5日，我警告奇利金，他不像《晚邮报》那样立场稳固，仅凭这一点，如果他停止发布此类新闻内容，即使是从其他报纸转载的，也将极大地符合他自身的利益。他向我保证，他无意制造麻烦，并将确保遵循我的建议。

现附上5月1日和5日的《Novosti Dnia》以及4月29日的《晚邮报》剪报，均与本投诉有关。

上海公共租界工部局秘书

Complaint against "Russian Daily News" Date 21 5 39

Inasmuch as the Council has the responsibility of censoring
the Press, I much regret to note that on Page 1 of the Russian
daily of 1st May published by the Publishing House at No. 620
Avenue Foch, International Settlement, there is a groundless
report couched in terms of disrespect to the Imperial House of
the Manchu Empire and also a statement that Japan, an ally of
Manchukuo, seems to harbour territorial ambitions against the
said Empire.

This false report, which constitutes lese-majesty, was
fabricated with the object of damaging the friendly relations,
and creating ill-feelings between Japan and Manchukuo. Those
who are informed on the actual conditions in Manchukuo, cannot
fail to see the falsity of the report.

The Manchu Empire and her ally Japan are working on a basis
of close relationship to build up a new order in East Asia, and
to achieve a historic feat of supreme importance. We firmly
believe that Manchukuo is the foundation on which East Asia is
to be reconstructed.

In the meantime, the fruitless war of resistance continues,
and China is being ruined. The mistakes made by the Chungking
Government in directing the moral life of the Chinese nation,
are not known to the people, who have been thrown into a state of
excitement. The Chinese public must be clearly informed of the
actual conditions in Manchukuo so that they may realize the
significance of a new order in East Asia, and the three countries,
Japan, Manchukuo and China, may enjoy real happiness. We, being
of the same race, should make known to the Chinese people the
experience we have gone through so that the Chinese people may

上海满洲国商务副代表致主席信函译文。
副本
日期 1939年5月16日 上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. S. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 4665
针对《Russian Daily News》（俄罗斯日报）的投诉 日期 39年5月21日

鉴于工部局负有审查新闻界的责任，我深感遗憾地注意到，5月1日出版、由法租界福煦路620号出版社发行的俄文日报第一版上，有一篇毫无根据的报道，措辞对满洲帝国皇室不敬，并且还声称满洲国的盟友日本似乎对该帝国怀有领土野心。

这篇构成大不敬罪的虚假报道，旨在破坏友好关系，并在日本与满洲国之间制造恶感。了解满洲国实际情况的人，不难看出该报道的虚假性。

满洲帝国及其盟友日本正基于密切关系，致力于建立东亚新秩序，并完成一项具有至高重要性的历史壮举。我们坚信，满洲国是重建东亚的基础。

与此同时，无效的抵抗战争仍在继续，中国正在遭到毁灭。重庆政府在指导中华民族道德生活方面所犯的错误，并不为处于兴奋状态的民众所知。必须向中国公众清楚通报满洲国的实际情况，以便他们认识到东亚新秩序的意义，使日本、满洲国和中国三国享受真正的幸福。我们同种同源，应向中国人民告知我们所经历的经验，以便中国人民

- 1 -

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处总监办公室 1939年5月23日）

pages.en:
- 2 -
correct their own views as soon as possible. It is my
principal duty to bring about genuine friendship between
the nationals of the three countries, Japan, Manchukuo and
China.
Considering my mission I cannot remain inactive in
the face of the unfortunate incident which occurred recently
in the area under the Council's jurisdiction. There are
numerous problems, arising out of the present conditions
of the Shanghai Settlement, which must be solved once and
for all. I cannot understand why up to the time of the
present case the Council has allowed full freedom to the
said newspaper which takes advantage of the special position
of the Settlement to indulge in anti-Manchukuo and anti-
Japanese propaganda, and why no steps have been taken to
curb such activity. Moreover, the journal in question has
not only been consistently hostile towards Japan and Manchukuo,
but it is closely connected with the Communist Party. It is
the Council's serious responsibility in exercising its
function to maintain peace and good order in the Settlement; not
to deal properly with this highly harmful publication is to fail
to act up to the responsibility.
I now venture to request the Council to take adequate
steps to deal with this matter. At the same time I beg to
present the following three demands, and I hope also that the
Council will effectively guarantee that no similar incidents
will recur in future. The demands are:-
1. That the said newspaper, "Russian Daily News",
be ordered to suspend publication forthwith.
2. That the paper be not allowed to resume
publication under whatever new name.
3. That the Editor-in-chief, S. I. Veis, of the
said newspaper be severely punished.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
尽快纠正自己的观点。促成日本、满洲国和中国三国国民之间的真正友谊，是我的主要职责。
考虑到我的使命，面对近期在工部局管辖区域内发生的不幸事件，我不能无所作为。上海租界目前的状况产生了诸多问题，必须一劳永逸地解决。我不理解，为何直至本案发生前，工部局一直允许该报享有完全自由，利用租界的特殊地位肆意进行反满洲国和反日本宣传，且未采取任何措施遏制此类活动。此外，该刊物不仅一贯敌视日本和满洲国，而且与共产党有着密切联系。工部局在行使维持租界和平与良好秩序职能方面负有重大责任；不妥善处理这份极具危害性的出版物，即是未能履行职责。
我现在冒昧请求工部局采取适当措施处理此事。同时，我谨提出以下三项要求，并希望工部局能有效保证今后不再发生类似事件。要求如下：
1. 命令上述报纸《Russian Daily News》（俄罗斯日报）立即停刊。
2. 不允许该报以任何新名称复刊。
3. 严惩上述报纸主编 S. I. Veis。

pages.en:
- 3 -

It is hoped that the above demands will be
sincerely and effectively complied with. Reply solicited.

(Signed and chopped)

Wong Ch'ing-tsang

Commercial Deputy for Manchukuo in
Shanghai.

(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 17th May, 1939.)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL MAY 18 1939 TRANSLATION OFFICE）

C. Kliene
pages.zh:
- 3 -

希望上述要求能得到真诚有效的执行。盼复。

（签名并盖章）

Wong Ch'ing-tsang（王庆藏，音译）

驻上海满洲国商务副代表。

"Novosti Dnia", May 5,1939. Published by the Russian Publish-
ing Co., 620 Avenue Foch. Editor - Mr. A.I. Veiss.

FROM THE EDITOR OF THE "NOVOSTI DNIA"

От редакціи газеты „Новости Дня“.

Вчера японское телеграфное агентство „Домеи“ разослало всѣм газетам бюл-
летень, въ котором привело статью японской же газеты „Тайрику Шимпо“, обвиняющую на-
шу газету въ оскорбленіи трона Манчжуо и въ желаніи нарушить миръ въ Международ-
ном Сеттльментѣ.

Статья газеты „Тайрику Шимпо“ и комментаріи агентства „Домеи“ являют-
ся съ начала и до конца лживыми и провокаціонными, им преслѣдуется исключительно цѣль
дискредитировать доброе имя нашей газеты и создать у оффиціальных лицъ и уч-
режденій впечатлѣніе, что газета „Новости Дня“ не подчиняется правилам о поддержаніи
мира и спокойствія въ Шанхаѣ.

Все это заставляет нас, газету „Новости Дня“, обратиться за защитой нашего
добраго имени въ Императорскій Консульскій Суд Японіи съ обвиненіем агентства „До-
меи“ и газеты „Тайрику Шимпо“ въ клеветѣ, диффамаціи, подрывѣ общественнаго довѣ-
рія и натравливаніи одной части населенія на другую.

Нашим адвокатом является мотр Поль Преме.

Yesterday the Japanese News Agency "Domei" sent out to all
newspapers bulletins containing an article from the Japanese
newspaper "Tairiku Shimpo", in which our journal is accused with
having insulted the Throne of Manchukuo and with the intention
of causing a breach of the peace in the International Settlement.
The article of the "Tairiku Shimpo" as well as the comments of
the "Domei"News Agency are a tissue of lies and provocation
from the beginning to the end their sole aim being to discredit
the good name of our journal and to create an impression in the
official circles that the newspaper "Novosti Dnia" does not con-
form with the regulations governing the maintenance of the peace
and order in Shanghai.
All this compels us, the newspaper "Novosti Dnia", to apply to
the Imperial Japanese Consular Court in order to defend our good
name and to accuse the "Domei" News Agency and the newspaper "Ta-
iriku Shimpo" with libel, defamation, prejudicing public confi-
dence and inciting one part of the population against another.
Maitre Paul Premet is our legal advisor,

昨日，日本“同盟”通讯社向所有报社发送了简报，其中引用了日本报纸《大陆新报》（Tairiku Shimpo）的一篇文章，指责我社侮辱满洲国皇统，并意图破坏国际租界的和平。
《大陆新报》的文章以及“同盟”通讯社的评论从头到尾都是谎言和挑衅，其唯一目的就是要败坏我社的良好声誉，并在官方圈子中造成一种印象，即《Novosti Dnia》报纸不符合维持上海和平与秩序的法规。
所有这一切迫使我们，《Novosti Dnia》报社，向日本帝国领事法庭申请保护我们的名誉，并指控“同盟”通讯社和《大陆新报》犯有诽谤、诋毁、损害公众信任以及煽动一部分居民反对另一部分居民的罪行。

"Novosti Dnia", May 1, 1939

PU-YI's SPOUSE

Супруга Пу-И

Супруга Генри Пу-И, нынешнего императора Маньчжоу-Го.
У нее развивается туберкулез... и нет сына! Говорят из-за этого чувствуют себя автор в грандиозных планах на север. Тем более, что Пу-И отказывается взять конкубинку для того, чтобы иметь наследника.

The spouse of Henry Pu-Yi, present Emperor Kang Teh of Manchukuo.
She is suffering from tuberculosis ... and has no son! It is said that this has a hampering effect on Japan's grandiose plans in the North, especially as Pu-Yi refuses to take a concubine in order to have a heir.

溥仪的配偶

Супруга Пу-И

Супруга Генри Пу-И, нынешнего императора Маньчжоу-Го.
У нее развивается туберкулез... и нет сына! Говорят из-за этого чувствуют себя автор в грандиозных планах на север. Тем более, что Пу-И отказывается взять конкубинку для того, чтобы иметь наследника.

亨利·溥仪（Henry Pu-Yi，即康德皇帝）的配偶，现任满洲国皇帝。
她患有肺结核……并且没有儿子！据说这对日本在北方的宏伟计划产生了阻碍作用，尤其是因为溥仪拒绝纳妾以生育继承人。
